ErrorBody.description:
JSON shape returned for every error response — `{error, code}`, plus `field` when the refusal
names one field of the request.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable code (see `CalmError::code`). Four more are written by routes
directly: `forbidden_tool`, `not_a_card_tool`, `tool_call_failed`, `login_throttled`.

error.description:
The reason, without the variant's log prefix (`CalmError::reason`): a 404 says `plugin x`,
not `not found: plugin x`; the `code` already says which kind of failure it is.

field.description:
The dotted path of the one field the refusal is about (`config.retries`,
`template_input.issue_url`); `error` is then that field's reason alone. Absent rather than
required because only `CalmError::InvalidField` names a field: every other error is about
the request as a whole, and an empty path would be a second way to say so.

MarkReadRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/read-receipts/{kind}/{targetId}/read`: the activity instant the reader has seen.

ReadReceiptKind.description: What a receipt is about: a track, or one conversation. A closed set, checked by the table too.

flow.description: Initial Flow nodes in the flow.v1 format.

messageId.description: Stable identity shared with the submitted user message.

turnId.description: Null for epoch_boundary and archived interrupted user/system items.

payload.description: Reset archives preserve exact user content or critical wake content, with status=interrupted, archived=true, reason=session_reset, and source epoch. Exhausted wakes use reason=max_attempts_exceeded.

queueHandoffIds.description: Recent queue identities whose user rows were committed to history.

canSteer.description: Whether the current active turn supports steering.

permissionModes.description: Permission options reported by this conversation's open provider session, when known.

reason.description: session_lost invalidates reconnect and fences queue/wake dispatch until explicit reset_context.

ReadReceiptDto.description:
One target's receipt. `readThroughMs` only rises; `manualUnread` is the reader's explicit
"mark unread", cleared by the next mark read.

ReadReceiptsResponseDto.description:
`GET /api/v1/read-receipts`: the cutover baseline (activity at or before it is read) and every
stored receipt.
